as_told.title: Government has held secret physics since the end of World War II

plain: Since the Second World War, the US government is said to have run secret research into the basic laws of physics. Matthew Pines, an analyst, says on the show that it is "very clear" to him the government has been doing this, without naming a source. James Valor, who works with a startup that tries to call UFOs into view, agrees with the thinker Eric Weinstein. He says the government probably has "top secret physics, knowledge and science" going back at least to the end of the war. Both give it as their view, not as something they saw. If true, it would mean there is a hidden science far ahead of what the public knows.
